board.label: Board

empty.title: Your vision starts here
empty.body: Add a photo of your goal, a quote that keeps you going, or a few words about where you are headed. You can also drop images right here.

quoteDialog.title: Add a quote
quoteDialog.description: The quote appears in the middle of the board. You can move it later.
quoteDialog.author: Author

textDialog.title: Add text
textDialog.description: A heading for big goals, a note for the details.
textDialog.heading: Heading

import.unsupported: “{{name}}” is not a supported image. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF.
import.failed: The images could not be added. Please try again.

trayNotice.title: Vision Board keeps running
trayNotice.body: The window closes, but Vision Board stays in the notification area next to the clock (in the menu bar on macOS). Open your board or quit the app from there at any time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.saveError: The change could not be saved. Please try again.

autostart.label: Start when I sign in
autostart.hint: Vision Board starts in the notification area, without opening a window.
autostart.error: Starting with the system could not be changed.

control.label: Desktop control
control.hint: A small bar on your desktop. Click it to open the settings, drag it anywhere you like.
control.layerHint: Behind windows it shows only on the free desktop and never gets in the way. In front of windows it always stays on top.

reset.title: Restore default settings?
reset.body: All settings return to their defaults and starting with the system is turned off. Your board stays as it is.

frames.label: Default image frame
frames.hint: You can change it for a single image in its menu.
frames.locked: The “{{name}}” frame is part of the Almost-there.eu gift. Unlock it with your gift code.

imagesOnly.label: Images only
imagesOnly.hint: Quotes and texts are hidden, not deleted.

placement.label: Board placement
placement.hint: Used by the scheduled display and the wallpaper, the same on every monitor.
placement.preview: Preview of the placement on the screen
